blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — A public official’s repeated omission of required information from his or her statement of assets, liabilities and net worth (SALN) may be attempted concealment and constitute dishonesty, retired Sandiganbayan Presiding Justice Amparo Cabotaje-Tang told the Senate impeachment court Monday. The House prosecution presented Cabotaje-Tang to outline a framework for allegation of the second impeachment article that Vice President Sara Duterte filed incomplete or untruthful SALNs from 2022 to 2024. Duterte has denied the allegation and the other charges in the impeachment case. Article II also accuses Duterte of amassing wealth disproportionate to her lawful income and failed to divest […]...
